title: Related organizations and private access infrastructure
summary: Depth-3 organization map from venture capital to private access infrastructure.

sources.title: J.D. Vance has raised $93 million for Narya
Trump-aligned club for the ultra rich launches in Washington

data.question: How does the Palantir–Thiel–Vance graph extend through related organizations and Trump-aligned access infrastructure?
data.method: Depth-bounded organization expansion with corporate, FEC, government and major-media sources; explicit disambiguation of two Executive Branch entities.
data.framework: venture capital -> electoral finance -> donor network -> investment firm -> private access venue
data.scope: Depth 2:Mithril, Narya, Protect Ohio Values and Rockbridge. Depth 3:Buskirk, 1789 Capital, Donald Trump Jr. and the private Executive Branch club.
findings: Mithril and Narya form the venture layer around Thiel and Vance.
Protect Ohio Values is the electoral-finance layer.
Rockbridge is the donor and institution-building layer.
Buskirk links Rockbridge to 1789 Capital; 1789 also lists Omeed Malik and Donald Trump Jr.
The private Executive Branch club creates a discreet social venue and is not the federal executive branch.
conclusions: The graph shows specialized investment, donor, electoral and private-access organizations.
Current evidence does not prove that club membership purchased a policy outcome or Palantir award.
counterarguments: The firms and club can serve ordinary commercial or social functions.
Public evidence does not resolve a membership-to-decision causal chain.
limitations: Rockbridge financial and legal records remain incomplete.
Private club membership and payments are not public.
1789 portfolio exposure to government action is unresolved.
unresolved: Private club member, event and access ledger

counterevidence: No reviewed source proves quid pro quo access or a contract caused by club membership.
